title: scirpus lacustris subsp. glaucus
intro: Scirpus lacustris subsp. glaucus, commonly known as the blue rush, is a plant species within the sedge family (Cyperaceae). This plant has been used for its health benefits, including its potential to aid in digestion and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of blue rush are believed to be due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Furthermore, the bioactive constituents of Scirpus lacustris subsp. glaucus may possess antioxidant and antimicrobial properties.
